data.headline: Take your performance anywhere.
data.description:
If you were expecting a creatine gummy, you’re not alone.

Creatine Chews are actually pressed tablets, tart and sweet, and intentionally not gummy in texture.

Here are the facts: add water to creatine and it breaks down into creatinine, a byproduct of creatine your body can’t use. A dry, pressed tablet keeps the creatine stable and intact all the way to you.
